At least for the moment.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref>}}
The '''Conclave of Chanosant''' was held on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chanosant]] in an effort to recruit support for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. It took place concurrently with a Separatist [[Battle of Lanos|assault]] on [[Lanos]], which was thus publicized as a liberation from the "corrupt and decayed" [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
